body:
On the back: “late Wednesday, emerald flecks in the cab after the crop trial. the chickens stopped moving in the yard.”

The flecks were still on the seat the next morning.
title: Annotated photograph

body: The officials at the gate were counting people in each vehicle. I heard them argue about whether to count heads or just cars. They each wrote down different numbers on their clipboards.
title: Checkpoint notes
